```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
# Keyed on the CFBD athlete id and the nflverse gsis id, never on name.
subjects <- tibble::tribble(
  ~who             , ~cfb_athlete_id , ~gsis_id     ,
  "Shane Buechele" , "4039034"       , "00-0036679" ,
  "Kyle Allen"     , "559681"        , "00-0034577"
)
# One row per player-season on the college roster or the NFL roster, with a
# draft status checked against the draft records.
spine <- player_trajectory(
  subjects,
  roster = tbl(con, "roster"),
  nfl_rosters = tbl(con, "nfl_rosters"),
  nfl_draft_picks = tbl(con, "nfl_draft_picks")
)
contract_player_trajectory(spine)
# Team colours for display only (decision 0008); NFL clubs come from nflverse
# because teams.parquet holds college programs only.
college_meta <- tbl(con, "teams") |>
  select(team, color) |>
  collect() |>
  transmute(team = team, name = team, color = color)
nfl_meta <- nflreadr::load_teams(current = FALSE) |>
  transmute(team = team_abbr, name = team_name, color = team_color)
team_lookup <- bind_rows(college_meta, nfl_meta) |>
  distinct(team, .keep_all = TRUE)
spine <- spine |>
  filter(season <= 2026) |>
  left_join(team_lookup, by = "team") |>
  mutate(
    color = coalesce(color, "gray60"),
    tooltip = paste0(name, " · ", season),
    who = factor(who, levels = c("Kyle Allen", "Shane Buechele"))
  )
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: draft-records
#| output: false
# Draft status checked in both draft sources, each on its own id namespace:
# CFBD picks on the college athlete id, nflverse picks on the NFL player id.
con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
cfbd_draft_rows <- vapply(
  as.integer(subjects$cfb_athlete_id),
  \(id) {
    tbl(con, "picks") |>
      filter(collegeAthleteId == !!id) |>
      count() |>
      pull(n)
  },
  numeric(1)
)
nflverse_draft_rows <- vapply(
  subjects$gsis_id,
  \(id) {
    tbl(con, "nfl_draft_picks") |>
      filter(gsis_id == !!id) |>
      count() |>
      pull(n)
  },
  numeric(1)
)
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
path_summary <- spine |>
  group_by(who) |>
  summarise(
    last_college = last(name[stage == "College"]),
    nfl_seasons = n_distinct(season[stage == "NFL"]),
    n_clubs = n_distinct(team[stage == "NFL"]),
    club_2026 = name[stage == "NFL" & season == 2026][1],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    draft_rows = cfbd_draft_rows + nflverse_draft_rows
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: draft-table
path_summary |>
  transmute(
    Player = as.character(who),
    `Last college team` = last_college,
    `Draft records found` = draft_rows,
    `NFL roster seasons` = nfl_seasons,
    `NFL clubs` = n_clubs,
    `2026 club` = club_2026
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c(
      "Player",
      "Last college team",
      "Draft records found",
      "NFL roster seasons",
      "NFL clubs",
      "2026 club"
    ),
    caption = "NFL record through 2026. Draft records found counts matching rows in both the CFBD and nflverse draft-pick tables; both players have none."
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
# Each row is one player, each tile one roster season, coloured by team. A team
# run (consecutive seasons at one school) is labelled once at its midpoint, so the
# thumbnail names each school without a legend.
runs <- spine |>
  arrange(who, season) |>
  group_by(who) |>
  mutate(run = cumsum(team != lag(team, default = ""))) |>
  group_by(who, run, team, color) |>
  summarise(start = min(season), end = max(season), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(mid = (start + end) / 2)
p <- ggplot(spine, aes(season, who)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = color), colour = "white", height = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    data = runs,
    aes(x = mid, label = team),
    colour = "white",
    size = 3.6,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(spine$season), max(spine$season), 2)) +
  labs(
    title = "Two schools each, then the NFL without a draft pick",
    subtitle = "Team by roster season, college then NFL",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "none")

card_thumbnail(p, "allen-buechele-college-to-nfl", release = release)

p_int <- ggplot(spine, aes(season, who)) +
  geom_tile_interactive(
    aes(fill = color, tooltip = tooltip, data_id = paste(who, season)),
    colour = "white",
    height = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = runs,
    aes(x = mid, label = team),
    colour = "white",
    size = 3.6,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(spine$season), max(spine$season), 2)) +
  labs(
    title = "Team by roster season, college then NFL",
    subtitle = "Hover any tile for the team and season",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "none")
card_interactive(p_int)
```

```{r}
#| label: nfl-stints
# One bar segment per contiguous stint with a club, placed on the season axis so
# the order of arrival reads left to right.
stints <- spine |>
  filter(stage == "NFL") |>
  arrange(who, season) |>
  group_by(who) |>
  mutate(stint = cumsum(team != lag(team, default = ""))) |>
  group_by(who, stint, team, name, color) |>
  summarise(start = min(season), end = max(season), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(seasons = end - start + 1)
p_nfl <- ggplot(stints) +
  geom_rect_interactive(
    aes(
      xmin = start - 0.5,
      xmax = end + 0.5,
      ymin = as.integer(who) - 0.3,
      ymax = as.integer(who) + 0.3,
      fill = color,
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "%s: %s, %d to %d (%d season%s)",
        who,
        name,
        start,
        end,
        seasons,
        if_else(seasons == 1, "", "s")
      ),
      data_id = paste(who, stint)
    ),
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = (start + end) / 2, y = as.integer(who), label = team),
    colour = "white",
    size = 4.4,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2018:2026) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(levels(spine$who)),
    labels = levels(spine$who)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "An NFL roster every season without a draft pick",
    subtitle = "NFL clubs by season, one segment per stint",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Hover a segment for the club and its seasons."
  ) +
  theme_card() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
card_interactive(p_nfl)
```
